headline: Morgan Stanley Retains Positive View on Greek Lenders Alpha Bank and Eurobank
summary: Morgan Stanley reiterated a positive stance on Greek banks, naming Alpha Bank its top pick and pointing to Eurobank's earnings upside supported by robust loan growth and expanding capital distributions.
why: Greek banks have undergone extensive balance-sheet cleanups following the sovereign debt crisis, recently reinstating shareholder dividends and improving credit ratings.
